author: ViceTechnicolour
body:
Spawn gives you the option of two portals (as seen in the album). You can choose left or right, and to defend your left or right core. Keep in mind this only shows one side, so the other side will be about the same. You have defense supplies, limited TNT to help blow the dam, and boats to help you navigate through the map (if you choose to). This is by far the largest map I have made in a while!

Special Thanks To:
- Fouled (Frontlines, Map Trimming, Cabin, Cave)
- Passively (Iron Cave Work, Supply Chests)
- Prodigy4532 (Server Help)

Images: http://imgur.com/a/shB5i

This map will be free to use on any scrimmage server, public server, and a download will be given, if this post reaches 20 replies. :D

replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body:
To those saying that it's a rip-off:
- There can be more than one Dam-styled PvP map in the entirety of Minecraft.
- I assure that the layout is entirely different from "Hot Dam" and it will play entirely different.

- This map uses portals, TNT, has a sides concept, has two dams per side, has a much different split and angle, has almost everything completely different from the other map. Comparing it to Hot Dam, I understand, but calling it a ripoff is completely nitpicky and factually inaccurate. If you cared to look at the map, the dam isn't even built on the same premise. I would be more interested to know HOW the maps are the same, if it's just such a problem, and I can adjust it as needed. Keep in mind I was working with the people I credited and not once did I, nor anyone, say anything about copying another map.

It's an Avicus map, I fail to see how it is similar other than being a dam, and it's ridiculous that there are assumptions I ripped off someone else's work. There is no plagiarism whatsoever, I'm not known for copying and stealing maps, and I would like comments that are constructive.

Stay on topic.

replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body:
I do like that idea, but I think controlled explosions could be chaotic when people step across the dam and accidentally blow the whole thing up. It's not thick enough to withstand TNT in general, I was hoping people would use it in more locations other than the dam a bit too.

If it doesn't play well with TNT, and ends up being too easy to defend, I'll probably remove the TNT for gameplay.
